name: pricing-section
title: Pricing Section
description: A plan comparison section with a monthly or annual billing selector and caller-supplied actions. It accepts plans with names, descriptions, monthly and annual display prices, feature lists, and action nodes. Use it when visitors need to compare plan cost and included benefits; clarify billing terms and currency in the supplied price copy, and use Feature Comparison when feature differences matter more than checkout.
docs: Requires `cn` at `@/lib/utils`. Supply already formatted display prices and accurate billing terms; the component does not calculate tax, currency conversions, or subscription totals.

meta.engineeringNotes: Treats displayed prices as caller-formatted strings rather than embedding locale, currency, tax, and billing arithmetic in a presentation block. A native button pair with aria-pressed makes the billing selection keyboard operable without requiring a switch widget for two labelled choices. Plan actions are slots so consumers can connect them to their own checkout or sales flows.
meta.motionNotes: The billing selection updates price text immediately with no number-counting effect, since animated price changes can obscure the actual amount. Selected styling and the explicit billing note communicate the current state. Reduced-motion preferences do not alter the text or action availability.
